summary: Problem statements are largely faithful, but the solutions for problems 1–5 are heavily garbled, condensed or truncated relative to the printed solutions, and one figure crop (p1-sol-fig2) captures text instead of the figure while p1-sol-fig1 swallows body text.

defects.description: Solution 1 is heavily garbled: 'ъглов диаметър' rendered as 'тълов диаметър', 'б' instead of 'δ', 'издвач' for 'идващ', sentences reordered/merged; the explanation of the two moments T1/T2 (fig. 1б/1в situations) and the sentence introducing the displacement of the Sun are missing; a fragment of the fig.2 discussion ('В случай разглеждаме само лъча b₁…') is wrongly appended inside the fig.2 paragraph, replacing the printed text about the visual ray to the zenith and the half of the solar disk.
defects.suggestedFix: Retranscribe solutions pp.1–3 verbatim: the beam/penumbra paragraph, the T1/T2 paragraph with 'Пълтната сянка на колоната ще изчезне, когато Слънцето … западен край на видимия слънчев диск застане в зенита…', ΔT = (δ/360°)·24ʰ ≈ 2min, and the fig.2 paragraph 'Зрителен лъч от наблюдателя Р към зенита ще съвпада с правата… над хоризонта ще бъде точно половината от слънчевия диск. Това ще е и частта от него, която осветява точката Р.'

defects.description: Crop for fig.2 (box [300,500,650,850]) shows a fragment of body text from the right column, not the drawing of the solar disk above the horizon with the column cross-section; the figure occupies roughly the lower-left/centre of page 2 (approx. x 250–700, y 560–840 permille) with caption 'Фиг. 2' at ~y 820.
Crop for figs 1a/1б/1в (box [0,0,1000,500]) extends far below the drawings and swallows the entire body paragraph 'Означаваме с T1…' and the ΔT formula.

Solution 2 is condensed and garbled: the reasoning that M31 lies ~20° from the Galactic plane, that the observer in M31 sees the SOUTH galactic pole (hence A is nearer than B), the apex coordinates α≈18ʰ, δ≈+30°, the clockwise-vs-counterclockwise argument, and the Sun's position at 2a/3 on the major axis are all missing or replaced by invented connectors ('Северният галактичен полюс е в посока към съзвездието на север. При движението на Луната…').
defects.suggestedFix: Retranscribe solutions pp.4–5 verbatim, including 'Ние виждаме M31 приблизително на 90° вляво от Стрелец…', the figure caption text with the Sun at distance 2a/3 right of centre, and the rotation-direction paragraph.

defects.description: sourceSpans list only solutions p.4, but the solution continues on p.5 (rotation direction, solar position figure).

Solution 3 drops the earthshine derivation: WЗ ~ (LС/rС²)AЗπRЗ², WЛН ~ (WЗ/rЛ²)AЛSЛ, the ratio WПП/WЛН = rЛ²/(AЗπRЗ²) ≈ 3000, and the sentence concluding that full moon is ~3000× brighter; 'свети' is twice written with a Latin 'i' ('светi'); 'WПН' printed as 'Wлн' vs candidate's 'WПН' inconsistency.
defects.suggestedFix: Retranscribe solutions pp.6–7 verbatim including the WПП/WЛН derivation, WПП/WЛН ≈ 3000, and Pogson line m₁ = m + 2,5 lg(WПП/WЛН).

defects.description: Printed magnitude uses a dot: '–12ᵐ.7'; candidate normalised to a comma '-12^{\mathrm{m}}{,}7'.

Solution 4 is truncated: the Kepler's-second-law derivation vПrП = vАrА, ωПrП² = ωАrА, δП/δА = rА/rП, TП/TА = rП/rА < 1, the conclusion that occultations are longest at apogee, and all three 'other conditions' (rotation direction/equator proximity, orbital sections parallel to the equator near solstices, Moon near zenith) are missing; the surviving text contains garbles ('в периця Луната в перигей е свое видимо движение закрива…', 'таза посока', 'тълов').
defects.suggestedFix: Retranscribe solutions pp.7–8 verbatim, ending with the three bulleted conditions on equatorial observers, solstice-position orbits and the Moon's proximity to the zenith.

defects.description: Second bullet of problem 5 is truncated: printed text continues '…съответстващи на означените със същите букви точки върху кривата на лъчевите скорости. Как е ориентирана тя спрямо зрителния лъч?' and adds 'Приемете, че зрителният лъч лежи в орбиталната равнина на тясната двойна система.' before the third bullet; also the printed clause 'и означете характерните точки – a, b, c, d' precedes the curve reference.
defects.suggestedFix: Нарисувайте приблизително как изглежда орбитата на тази звезда и означете характерните точки – a, b, c, d – съответстващи на означените със същите букви точки върху кривата на лъчевите скорости. Как е ориентирана тя спрямо зрителния лъч?

defects.description: Solution 5 is condensed: missing the correspondence of the velocity-curve parts (ab symmetric to bc, cd to da → major axis perpendicular to the line of sight; V_R = 0 at a and c; b approaching, d receding at periastron), the two possible orbit orientations, the momentum conservation M₁v₁ + M₂v₂ = 0 and v₁/v₂ = M₂/M₁ derivation, and the fact that the heavy component's radial velocity is three times smaller and opposite.
defects.suggestedFix: Retranscribe solutions pp.9–12 verbatim including the momentum equations and the periastron/apoastron identification of points d and b.

defects.description: sourceSpans list only solutions p.9, but the solution spans pp.9–12.
Crop p5-fig1 (box [150,200,600,500]) slightly clips the leftmost point '7' of the ellipse and the caption line 'фиг.1' just below; suggest widening left and bottom.
No points are printed anywhere in the paper; null is correct.
